SELECT p.c_identind,p.c_identmen,p.c_numero_npi,p.c_hl2a,p.c_hl2b,p.id,p.c_hl5m,p.c_hl5y
FROM app_fd_table_individus p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM app_fd_dossier_organisme
    WHERE c_id_organisme = '#requestParam.id_organisme#'
      AND c_id_dossier = p.id
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM app_fd_dossier_organisme
    WHERE c_id_dossier = p.id
      AND (c_issaved = 'true' or c_issaved = 'done')
)
AND 
p.c_status_profil <> 'Inactif' or p.c_status_profil is null
